plan.title: SRC-AWD-011 — Award all units to Vendor A without remark

steps.note: Opens the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enables the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Confirms both real bidder columns are present before awarding.
Confirms the requested quantity shown for Vendor A's bid.
Confirms Vendor A is the non-lowest bidder at 100 per unit.
Confirms Vendor B is the lower bidder at 90 per unit.
Opens the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocates all 10 units to Vendor A rather than the lowest bidder.
Checks that one line and one vendor are selected and the proposal value is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Creates and submits the award proposal for Vendor A using the allocation.
Confirms the proposal was created and submitted for approval.
Confirms the submitted proposal is pending approval.
Attempts approval with an empty remark and requires Procol to refuse it.
Confirms the proposal remains pending after the refused approval.
